never: order a line the job does not carry
type a price; the supplier catalogue is the only source
order twice for one job and supplier
release over threshold or accept a substitution without a person

provider_block.job: the materials are ordered from the job, from the catalogue, once

with_us.note: No hosted step. The idempotent write of the order into the system the business orders from is quoted as a scoped build.

checks.title: Every ordered line traces to a material line on the job
Stock on hand is read before the order, and a line stock covers is reserved rather than ordered
Every line carries the supplier's catalogue code and price, read at order time, and a line no catalogue holds parks the order
One order per job and supplier, written once, updated on a second run
An order over the threshold, or to a supplier not on the approved list, is released only by a named person
Each supplier carries a lead time, and an order that would miss the job's start tells the job owner
A delivery is recorded against the order line by line, and a delivery with no order is refused
Short, over, wrong item and a changed price are escalated with the order id and an owner, never absorbed
A supplier's substitution is accepted only by a named person
Every order, release, delivery and variance is retrievable by job
